description: One run rebuilt as the strategy it was, entry and exit rules with the parameter values the engine drew. This is the way OUT of a sweep: a row worth acting on becomes a saved strategy and then a real backtest over a window the person chose. Reach for it once a row is interesting, not for every row in a ranking.

config_hash.description: The row's config_hash, as find_sweep_runs reported it. Pass it whenever you have it: a relaunched sweep can give one run_index to several runs, and without it such an index is refused, not guessed.

experiment_id.description: The sweep, as create_sweep returned it.

run_index.description: Which run, as find_sweep_runs reported it.

name: get_sweep_run
